summary: security checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for continued private preview and preparation of an unsent permission request. Evidence: the security baseline is read-only and not certification; fleet-doctor, deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, container isolation, release controls, dependency risk, monitoring, incident handling, TLS detail, and disclosure readiness are unverified. Compliance also reports 16 failing and 6 unknown sites. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, authorize no public launch, monetization expansion, credential change, or security-sensitive deployment, and complete the security evidence gate before reconsideration. Optional hardening alone is not a fleet-wide blocker.

Continue only existing bounded, reversible report-only, repair, and measurement work that does not expand permissions, expose new data, change credentials, alter security controls, or create production launch risk. Missing telemetry and unavailable security sweeps must remain labeled as unavailable evidence, not passed checks. Reject new security-sensitive queue work until the owner and technical owners provide the required evidence.

Retain the private-preview gate. Preparation of an unsent permission request may proceed only after owner approval and must not send outreach, change access controls, alter production, or expand monetization. Public beta and full launch remain blocked pending source-rights, privacy, accuracy, attribution, and security evidence.
